review_notes: I read the whole file and the related Schwarz–Christoffel files (RegularEdge.lean, Asymptotic.lean) for other uses of `schwarzChristoffelContinuedIntegrand_ofReal`. Most repeated pieces are too short to count under the rubric: `isOpen_Ioo.preimage Complex.continuous_re`, `ordConnected_Ioo.uIcc_subset`, and the `by_cases a i ≤ c` splits. The one repetition I think is justified is the interval-case discharge of the hypotheses of `schwarzChristoffelContinuedIntegrand_ofReal` (lines 332–335 and 432–434). It is small, about two lines each, so this is a modest finding. I did not check the other call sites in RegularEdge.lean and Asymptotic.lean. The replacement is untested because I cannot run Lean.

findings.problem: Two proofs each re-derive, for a point of a prevertex-free interval `Ioo p q`, the two side conditions of `schwarzChristoffelContinuedIntegrand_ofReal` with reference point `p`. The argument is: a prevertex with nonzero exponent satisfying `a i ≤ p` lies below any `x > p`; one with `p < a i` cannot lie in `Ioo p q`, so it is `≥ q > x`. The second proof (lines 432–434) repeats the same two lambdas with `(hsub ht).1/.2` in place of `hx.1/.2`. Each use rebuilds this case analysis inline, so the hypotheses of `_ofReal` are re-proved for the same special case `c = p`, `x ∈ Ioo p q`.
findings.proposed_change:
Add, right after `schwarzChristoffelContinuedIntegrand_ofReal`:

theorem schwarzChristoffelContinuedIntegrand_ofReal_of_mem_Ioo (a e : ι → ℝ) {p q x : ℝ} (ha : ∀ i, e i ≠ 0 → a i ∉ Ioo p q) (hx : x ∈ Ioo p q) : schwarzChristoffelContinuedIntegrand a e p (x : ℂ) = (schwarzChristoffelDensity a e x : ℂ) :=
  schwarzChristoffelContinuedIntegrand_ofReal a e (fun i _ hi => hi.trans_lt hx.1) fun i he hi => hx.2.trans_le (not_lt.mp fun h => ha i he ⟨hi, h⟩)

The proof is the existing term from lines 334–335. Then `hval` in the tendsto theorem becomes `schwarzChristoffelContinuedIntegrand_ofReal_of_mem_Ioo a e ha hx`. In the `EqOn` block of the increment theorem, `h` becomes `schwarzChristoffelContinuedIntegrand_ofReal_of_mem_Ioo a e ha (hsub ht)`. Both uses have `ha` and an `Ioo p q` membership in scope, so no new imports or hypotheses are needed. The same lemma could also supply the strip-membership-to-`Ioo` step in `exists_tendsto_schwarzChristoffelPrimitive_injOn_collinear`, which has a similar `hne` argument.
findings.benefit: The edge case analysis (below `p` or above `q`) is stated and proved once, and each caller reads as one line. The two main theorems then show only their own analytic content: continuity of the extension, and the integral formula.
